inputs.prompts:
subject_definitions:
<Driver> is a tanned middle-aged man; only his forearms and black-leather-gloved hands are visible, gripping the steering wheel at ten and two.
<Ferrari> is a classic red vintage convertible with a glossy long hood, chrome grille and a chrome hood emblem, black leather interior and a white-gauged dashboard.
<Coast> is a winding Pacific Coast highway: deep blue ocean with whitecaps and scattered rocks to the right, dry golden-brown hills with green coastal scrub to the left.

summary:
A single continuous first-person driving shot from the driver's seat. No cuts, no transitions - one slow, smooth take. The <Ferrari> glides through a gentle right-hand curve, then the road straightens toward a hazy coastal plain.

detailed_description:
Cinematic live action, shot on 35mm film, golden hour late-afternoon light, fine natural grain. Warm orange and yellow glare pours through the windshield across polished chrome and leather; long shadows stretch from the front wheels. Fixed, eye-level POV camera mounted just behind the steering wheel, looking straight ahead over the hood, framing the road's center line.

[Shot 1] 00:00.000-00:10.000. Fixed POV over the hood. The <Ferrari> enters a gentle right-hand curve; the steering wheel rotates subtly in the <Driver>'s gloved hands, fingers tapping rhythmically. Whitecaps break on the <Coast>'s offshore rocks to the right while golden hills slide past on the left. As the road straightens, the wheel returns to center and the chrome hood emblem aligns with the vanishing point, where cliffs recede into a low hazy plain.

non_diegetic_music:
